RE: 

PulteGroup, Inc. 

Form 10-K for the Fiscal Year Ended December 31, 2010 

Filed February 10, 2011 

Response Letter Dated July 8, 2011 

File No. 1-09804 

We are in receipt of the
referenced letter dated August 1, 2011, which requires a response within 10 business days. Due to several situations, we formally request a response extension to no later than August 29, 2011 in order to provide adequate time to prepare
our response. 

This matter was informally discussed with Kevin Stertzel via telephone on August 12, 2011. 

Thank you for your consideration of this matter. 

Very truly yours, 

/s/ Michael J. Schweninger

Controller
